schema:name: Availability of National Health Workforce Accounts (NHWA)
schema:description: “A system by which countries progressively improve the availability, quality, and use of data on health workforce through monitoring of a set of indicators to support achievement of Universal Health Coverage, Sustainable Development Goals and other health objectives.” 29 indicators in 4 modules (National health workforce accounts: a handbook, 2nd ed. (WHO 2023, ISBN 9789240081291), Definition and A modular approach).
